description: Make date filtering effortless with the Date Range Slicer. Unlike standard slicers, this visual allows you to set dynamic default start and end dates using DAX measures, ensuring your users always see the most relevant data (e.g., "Last 30 Days" or "Current Month") upon opening the report. Key Features: Dynamic Defaults: Bind start/end dates to measures. Quick Picks: One-click presets for Yesterday, This Week, Month, Quarter, and Year. Fully Customizable: Control colors, fonts, borders, and transparency to match your report theme.
